title: Shortcut not working despite no detected conflicts

judgment.rationale: Use the existing dedicated-keyboard-thread work for the hook-reliability portion. Keep conflict-reporting expectations distinct from successful system-shortcut interception; do not promise #50982 resolves every warning/UI expectation.
evidence: Without the low-level hook, Win+S opens Windows Search; with the hook, both applications sometimes open.
The maintainer says the hook is required for system-shortcut override and points to #50982 for reliability.
A 'no conflict' UI result is not proof that Windows does not reserve a shortcut.
Read open #50982's GlobalHotkeyService/GlobalKeyboardHook changes: hooks run on a dedicated message loop with renewal and nonblocking callback requirements.
